meta.name: Rosemary-Garlic Focaccia (Grain-Free, Candida-Friendly)
meta.description: A savory grain-free focaccia for friends on a candida diet. Blanched almond flour and coconut flour replace wheat, psyllium husk builds structure, and roasted garlic with fresh rosemary carry the flavor. Not diet food — real bread with real character.

ingredients.name: Whole Garlic Head
ingredients.rationale: Roasted garlic is antifungal and mellows into sweet, buttery cloves — masks any eggy flavor

ingredients.name: Olive Oil (for roasting)
ingredients.rationale: Minimal oil needed to prevent garlic from drying out

ingredients.name: Blanched Superfine Almond Flour
ingredients.rationale: 5:1 ratio with coconut flour — universal in grain-free bread science

ingredients.name: Coconut Flour
ingredients.rationale: 5:1 ratio with almond flour; absorbs 4-5x its weight in liquid

ingredients.name: Aluminum-Free Baking Powder
ingredients.rationale: Double-acting for reliable chemical leavening

ingredients.name: Baking Soda
ingredients.rationale: Reacts with ACV for instant lift — never exceed 1/4 tsp to avoid soapy taste

ingredients.name: Fine Sea Salt
ingredients.rationale: ~1.6% of flour weight

ingredients.name: Fresh Rosemary
ingredients.rationale: Antimicrobial herb — candida-safe and flavor-forward

ingredients.name: Psyllium Husk Powder
ingredients.rationale: Forms gel network mimicking gluten. Increases gas-holding from 84% to 98%. Must be POWDER not whole husks

ingredients.name: Warm Water
ingredients.rationale: 10:1 water-to-psyllium is too high at 250ml; 120ml tested ratio for focaccia density

ingredients.name: Large Eggs (separated)
ingredients.rationale: 2 yolks + 4 whites reduces eggy flavor while maximizing lift from whipped whites

ingredients.name: Ghee (melted)
ingredients.rationale: Nutty, rich, high smoke point, essentially zero lactose — better flavor than coconut oil

ingredients.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
ingredients.rationale: Reacts with baking soda + prevents purple psyllium reaction

ingredients.name: Cream of Tartar
ingredients.rationale: Stabilizes whipped egg whites for longer hold during folding

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (topping)
ingredients.rationale: Generous EVOO is what makes focaccia — fruity, Mediterranean character

ingredients.name: Flaky Sea Salt (Maldon)
ingredients.rationale: Visible crystals on top for texture and presentation

ingredients.name: Black Pepper (cracked)
ingredients.rationale: Optional finishing touch — to taste

states.title: Prep Garlic Head
states.direction: Slice top off garlic head to expose cloves. Drizzle cut face with olive oil. Wrap tightly in aluminum foil.
states.exit_condition: Garlic top sliced, oiled, and wrapped in foil packet

states.title: Roast Garlic
states.direction: Place foil packet in oven. Roast 35-40 minutes until cloves are soft, golden, and easily squeezed from skins. Cool until handleable.
states.exit_condition: Cloves are golden, soft, and squeeze out easily — sweet aroma, no raw bite

notes.text: Start other prep during this time — hydrate psyllium, mix dry ingredients, separate eggs

reminders.prompt: How does the roasted garlic look/smell?

states.title: Hydrate Psyllium
states.direction: Whisk psyllium husk powder into warm water in medium bowl. Let sit 5 minutes until a thick gel forms.
states.exit_condition: Thick, cohesive gel — holds shape when scooped, no dry powder visible

notes.text: Must use psyllium husk POWDER, not whole husks. If using whole husks, use half the amount.
This gel is your gluten substitute — it forms the elastic network that traps gas from leavening.

states.title: Whisk Dry Ingredients
states.direction: Whisk almond flour, coconut flour, baking powder, baking soda, fine sea salt, and finely chopped rosemary in large mixing bowl.
states.exit_condition: Dry ingredients evenly combined, rosemary distributed throughout, no lumps

states.title: Separate Eggs
states.direction: Separate all 4 eggs. Place 2 yolks in medium bowl (with psyllium gel). Place all 4 whites in clean, grease-free stand mixer bowl. Reserve remaining 2 yolks for another use.
states.exit_condition: 2 yolks in wet bowl, 4 whites in clean mixer bowl, no yolk contamination in whites

notes.text: Any trace of yolk in the whites will prevent them from whipping to stiff peaks. Separate over a small bowl first.

states.title: Mix Wet Ingredients
states.direction: To the 2 yolks, add melted ghee, apple cider vinegar, psyllium gel, and half the roasted garlic (mash with a fork). Whisk until smooth.
states.exit_condition: Smooth wet mixture with garlic evenly distributed, no lumps of gel

states.title: Combine Wet and Dry
states.direction: Pour wet mixture into dry ingredients. Stir with rubber spatula until just combined — do not overmix.
states.exit_condition: Batter is uniformly mixed with no dry pockets, thick and cohesive

notes.text: Overmixing with an electric mixer creates hollow air pockets. Use a spatula and stop when just combined.

states.title: Rest Batter
states.direction: Let batter rest 5 minutes. Coconut flour continues absorbing liquid during this time.
states.exit_condition: Batter has thickened slightly and holds shape better than when first mixed

notes.text: Coconut flour absorbs 4-5x its weight in liquid and continues absorbing for 5-10 minutes after mixing. Don't judge batter consistency until after this rest.

states.title: Whip Egg Whites
states.direction: Add cream of tartar to all 4 egg whites in stand mixer bowl. Whip on high speed to stiff peaks, about 2-3 minutes.
states.exit_condition: Stiff peaks — whites hold their shape when whisk is lifted, tips point straight up

notes.text: True stiff peaks are critical for lift. Under-whipped whites = dense bread.

states.title: Fold in Whites (Two Additions)
states.direction: First addition: scoop half the whipped whites into the batter. Fold aggressively to lighten the mixture. Second addition: gently fold in remaining whites — cut down through center, sweep up sides. Stop when no white streaks remain.
states.exit_condition: No white streaks visible, batter is uniformly lightened and airy

notes.text: The first aggressive fold sacrifices some volume to make the batter workable. The second gentle fold preserves the air that gives the focaccia its rise.

states.title: Prep Pan
states.direction: Line 23cm round cake pan with parchment paper. Grease parchment with a thin layer of ghee or olive oil.
states.exit_condition: Pan lined with parchment, lightly greased and ready for batter

states.title: Spread Batter in Pan
states.direction: Gently transfer batter to prepared pan. Spread evenly with an offset spatula or the back of a spoon, keeping as much air as possible.
states.exit_condition: Batter evenly distributed in pan, surface roughly level

states.title: Dimple and Add Toppings
states.direction: Oil your fingers. Press dimples all over the surface. Push reserved roasted garlic cloves and whole rosemary leaves into dimples. Drizzle generously with EVOO. Sprinkle flaky salt and cracked pepper.
states.exit_condition: Dimples pressed across entire surface, garlic and rosemary nestled in, generous oil pooling in dimples, salt and pepper visible

notes.text: Be generous with the EVOO — it pools in the dimples and fries the surface during baking, creating the signature focaccia crust.

states.title: Bake at High Temperature
states.direction: Place pan in oven at 375°F (190°C). Bake 10 minutes to set the crust.
states.exit_condition: Surface has begun to set and lightly color, edges starting to pull from pan

notes.text: Reduce oven temperature BEFORE the garlic roast step ends. The two-temperature bake starts hot to set crust, then drops to finish gently.

states.title: Bake at Reduced Temperature
states.direction: Reduce oven to 350°F (175°C). Continue baking 25-30 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 200-205°F (93-96°C).
states.exit_condition: Golden brown top, internal temperature 200-205°F (93-96°C), edges pulling from pan

states.title: Cool in Pan
states.direction: Transfer pan to wire rack. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.
states.exit_condition: Focaccia has firmed enough to lift from pan without breaking

states.title: Cool Completely on Rack
states.direction: Remove focaccia from pan and transfer to wire rack. Cool COMPLETELY before slicing — minimum 1 hour, overnight is better.
states.exit_condition: Focaccia is room temperature throughout — no warm spots when pressed. Structure is fully set.

notes.text: Slicing while warm = gummy interior. The structure sets as it cools. This is non-negotiable.

reminders.prompt: How does the crumb look after slicing?

methods.detail: 350°F (175°C) for 5-7 minutes until warmed through and crust re-crisps
Pan-fry slices in ghee over medium heat until golden and crisp on each side, about 2 minutes per side
Toast slices directly from frozen — no thawing needed. 350°F (175°C) for 8-10 minutes or in a toaster
methods.reference: Community consensus — slice before freezing, freeze on sheet pan, then bag

techniques.name: Psyllium husk pre-hydration
techniques.sourcedFrom: Food science agent — 10:1 warm water ratio, 5-min gel formation
techniques.rationale: Increases gas-holding capacity from 84% to 98.5%, boosts volume ~50%, reduces firmness 65-75%

techniques.name: Separated egg white whipping
techniques.sourcedFrom: Food science + community agents — 2 yolks + 4 whites
techniques.rationale: Reduces eggy flavor while maximizing mechanical leavening from whipped whites

techniques.name: Two-temperature bake
techniques.rationale: High initial temp sets crust and triggers Maillard reaction; reduced temp finishes interior without over-browning

techniques.name: Dual leavening system
techniques.sourcedFrom: Food science agent — chemical (baking powder + ACV/soda) + mechanical (whipped whites)
techniques.rationale: Chemical leavening provides initial lift; whipped whites provide structure and airiness

techniques.name: Complete cooling before slicing
techniques.rationale: Structure sets as it cools; slicing warm produces gummy interior. Minimum 1 hour, overnight ideal.

techniques.name: Roasted garlic integration
techniques.rationale: Half mashed into dough for flavor base, half pressed into dimples for visual and textural interest

research.strategy: 4-agent parallel research: best recipes, food science, community intel, flavor optimization
